expectations.text: States the Act has nine chapters and 44 sections
expectations.evidence: Heading: "(44 sections, 9 chapters)" with full chapter table I-IX

expectations.text: Maps appeal to the Appellate Tribunal (TDSAT) to Section 29
expectations.evidence: "Section 29 provides that an order of the Board can be appealed to the Telecom Disputes Settlement and Appellate Tribunal (TDSAT)"

expectations.text: Maps Chapter VI to the Board's powers and procedure (ss.27-28) and Chapter VIII to penalties (ss.33-34)
expectations.evidence: Table: "VI | 27-28 | Powers, functions and procedure of the Board" and "VIII | 33-34 | Penalties and adjudication"

expectations.text: Does not cite any 'Section 31 limitation for filing complaints' (Section 31 is alternate dispute resolution)
expectations.evidence: "Section 31 (Chapter VII) allows the Board to refer disputes to mediation or other alternate dispute resolution" - no limitation-period claim
